guard: a persona saved over the wire keeps no launch options and grants only channels its definer holds
why: P1 keeps the prompt's launch options on a new wire persona, so a wider spawner launches with them.
P2 keeps a saved file's launch options through a redefine.
P3 bounds a definition only when it names capabilities or endpoints, so its channels go unchecked.
P4 drops the channels from the static bound. P5 drops them from the user-auth ledger bound.

mutations.name: P1 keep the prompt's launch options
mutations.replace:
muted: fromPrompt?.muted,
    launchOptions: fromPrompt?.launchOptions,
    meta: authored
mutations.expectRed: and the child is launched with none of the definer's options
mutations.cell: and the child is launched with none of the definer's options

mutations.name: P2 keep a saved file's launch options on redefine
mutations.expectRed: a redefine writes no launch options the saved file held
mutations.cell: a redefine writes no launch options the saved file held

mutations.name: P3 bound only a definition that names capabilities or endpoints
mutations.expectRed: a read channel the definer does not hold, from the prompt's frontmatter, is refused by name
mutations.cell: a read channel the definer does not hold, from the prompt's frontmatter, is refused by name

mutations.name: P4 drop the channels from the static definer bound
mutations.find: this.spawnBoundRefusal(bound, { capabilities, allowSubscribe, allowPublish, ...(endpoints.length ? { endpoints } : {}) }, false, "define-persona");
mutations.expectRed: a post channel the definer does not hold, as an argument, is refused by name
mutations.cell: a post channel the definer does not hold, as an argument, is refused by name

mutations.name: P5 drop the read channels from the user-auth definer bound
mutations.expectRed: a read channel beyond the definer's row is refused by name, writing nothing
mutations.cell: a read channel beyond the definer's row is refused by name, writing nothing
